data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 海风也不能命令我
data.description: 龙卷穿着黑绿色泳装悬浮在遮阳伞旁，手里端着冰镇青柠苏打；她故意把脚尖离开沙面，海风把卷发吹成一圈绿色光环，最后还是被浪花溅到裙边而恼怒地瞪向镜头。
data.action: 遮阳伞旁悬浮喝青柠苏打，被浪花溅到裙边后恼怒瞪海
data.lighting: hard noon sun softened by a turquoise parasol
data.mood: 把假日也过成超能力管辖区
data.promptProse: Tatsumaki hovers beside a turquoise parasol with citrus soda, glaring at a wave splashing her wrap skirt; its shade covers her face while noon light catches the droplets.
data.animaCaption: She glares at a wave splashing her wrap skirt beneath the turquoise parasol.
